annotation.title_clean: § 19.2-60.1. Use of unmanned aircraft systems by public bodies; search warrant required
annotation.title_en: § 19.2-60.1. Use of unmanned aircraft systems by public bodies; search warrant required
annotation.summary_en: Virginia statute requiring a search warrant for drone use by state and local law enforcement and regulatory bodies, with enumerated exceptions (alerts, emergencies, crash reconstruction, consent). Evidence from violations is inadmissible, and weaponized drones are banned except at Wallops Island facilities.
key_provisions_or_claims: Government agencies must obtain a warrant before using unmanned aircraft systems.
Warrantless exceptions include Amber/Senior/Blue Alerts, immediate danger, crash reconstruction, consent, and fleeing suspects.
Evidence obtained in violation is inadmissible in criminal or civil proceedings.
Weaponized drones are prohibited except at Wallops Island Space Port and Naval/Aegis facilities.
Private, commercial, recreational and research drone use and US Armed Forces/National Guard training are not restricted.
